note: Cerro Gordo County Conservation's first park, 38 acres in Rockwell along a meander of Beaver Dam Creek; public golf course, pool and tennis nearby. The long west row backs to the creek. Water fill and firewood on site. Sites 41-60 are grass, without pads. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50A electric-only, $20, online booking required, FCFS never, season; count 66 -> 60 (county and site pages 01-60). Creekside holds; pads measured.
flags: Creekside holds and is well earned: a west row of about 20 gravel pads north of the creek backs onto it, roughly 5-15 m from the water across grass, no road between (the road is at the pad heads); channel about 20-28 m, so creek not river, close to the 30 m line. County's own text calls sites 24 and 40 'waterfront' and 23 'by the creek'. Main loop (north, by the road) is inland.

Count: stored 66 was wrong: the county's page says 60 and site pages exist for 01-60 only. Shortest gravel pad is 25 ft (site 24 reads 27 ft; another 25); most 42-56, so a 23-ft rig fits. Site 24 at 27 ft is tight for it.
inclusion_evidence names 'Buena Vista CCB ... 60 sites': the operator is Cerro Gordo County Conservation. Wrong agency in the record, not written by this result.

PIN about 130 m east of the main loop: stored 42.97930,-93.19470 is on the entrance road in woods across the creek from the loop at 42.9797,-93.1963; the west row is near 42.9789,-93.1984.
